case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

PPI-C241 rose … in twelve months and is … of our cost.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

Thank you for setting out the cost drivers behind your offer. We recognise the genuine copper pressure and the importance of keeping Nordmark a healthy, reliable long-term partner.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

Our analysis supports a moderated fixed-price adjustment, with planning certainty and growing business providing a clear case for your internal review. We are flexible on payment terms; Option B retains your requested payment term, so please choose which package works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 350.66 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 346.01 per unit, payment 30 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 347.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

We value our long relationship and look forward to agreeing a sound basis for continued business.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your understanding of the significant copper cost pressure and welcome the positive volume forecast. 

Our offer is a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Taking the increased volume into account, we can adjust our offer to €369.76 per unit while maintaining the 30-day payment terms at our standard terms. This alternative offers a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This represents a fair concession that reflects the growing business while addressing the unavoidable material cost increases. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

Thank you for recognising the verified demand growth and reducing your offer. We accept the genuine copper pressure; our proposal uses the forecast rather than a binding volume commitment.

The German labour cost index for manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

We are making a modest upward step and ask you to reciprocate. A fixed price gives both sides planning certainty and offers a clear basis for your internal review alongside the verified demand outlook.

We propose: EUR 352.15 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We appreciate our long relationship and your continued work towards an agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have verified the labour cost index data you provided; however, it does not alter our pricing basis. Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, company policy prevents us from sharing detailed internal cost structures, though we have previously outlined the primary cost drivers. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

In response to your modest step, we can adjust our offer to a price of €372.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Petra Lechner,

Thank you for reducing your offer; we recognise the genuine copper pressure and respect your policy on confidential cost calculations. We also note that the verified labour index does not change your pricing basis and will not press that argument further.

We are making another modest upward price step and expect a reciprocal concession. Our proposal retains your offered payment terms and fixed pricing without an index clause in exchange for further price moderation, giving you a clear package for internal review.

We propose: EUR 353.65 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

We appreciate our long relationship and your continued work towards an agreement.

Kind regards
